messages:
matt: FYI Sparrow (dedicated pool sparrow-prod) hit sustained 429s + token-per-second SLO violations during a marketing blast ~15:20 UTC. Customer reports burst credits went to 0 and requests were rejected. Ticket #12345 linked.
anya: Pulling admission & billing logs for sparrow-prod now. Can you confirm account id and exact window?
matt: account=acct-sparrow. Window roughly 1769123000 -> 1769123300. App log excerpt: `429 admission_control.rejected reason=burst_credits_depleted tokens=0`.
prateek: I see an anomaly in the burst accounting for that GPU pool. Prewarm/preprovisioning tokens were being attributed to tenant credits due to a tag propagation bug from last week's deploy. Trying a quick repro in staging.
prateek: Repro in staging (quick curl used to simulate sustained TPS):
```
# repro
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/dedicated/admit \
  -H "X-Account: acct-sparrow" \
  -d '{"tps": 1800, "seq_len": 512}'
```
anya: Corroborating metrics: KV cache miss rate spiked, request queue depth increased, but autoscaler didn't kick because admission returned 429s early — so the scaler never observed the queue delta it expects.
chloe: I've told Sparrow's CSM and offered a temporary capacity bump. They want RCA and an ETA for a fix and credit reconciliation.
prateek: Root cause: tag propagation bug + a race in admission accounting that counted internal/prewarm allocations against tenant burst credits. Fix plan: back out tag change or hotfix admission to ignore tokens with internal tag. Hotfix ETA ~2h; rollback path available if needed.
matt: Which deploy introduced the tag change?
deploy-bot: Deployment info: PR 4213 merged and rolled to prod at 1769000000 by prateek. Rollback command: `helm rollback admission-service 2`.
anya: Short-term mitigation applied: increased headroom for sparrow-prod pool by +20% and enabled permissive fallback policy for 30m to let through traffic while we fix accounting. I'll monitor admission_rejections, burst_credit_usage, and queue_depth.
prateek: After hotfix we'll run a credits reconciliation job to retroactively top up any unfairly consumed burst credits for acct-sparrow. Also adding unit coverage for tag-propagation and an integration test to prevent admission accounting regressions.
matt: Notifying customer now. Will update with timeline and confirm once credits have been adjusted.
chloe: Sparrow accepts the temporary bump. Please DM me when reconciliation is done and include the postmortem link for billing impact.
anya: Monitoring looks better after headroom bump; admission rejects dropping. If no regressions, proceed with hotfix rollout this afternoon and follow up with postmortem.
_note: No title field included per agents.md. Messages are a single continuous string with speakers prefixed.
